candidates.raw_title: China NMPA, early/mid-Nov 2026 -- Dupixent (dupilumab) indication expansion to chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (adults/adolescents); Pfizer marstacimab new indication, same period
candidates.reject_reason: Gate A: an indication expansion with no concentration/device/formulation angle is explicitly out of scope per the standing ruling (device/indication-only SC items are rejected unless concentration or volume is the subject). Source also could not confirm the year (zh-language aggregator did not state it explicitly), so date is unconfirmed regardless.

candidates.reject_reason: Gate A: none of these are SC high-concentration delivery technology or tracked-molecule installed-base events; unrelated therapeutic classes/formulations.
